explanation: Only fires at D1, and only right after a trial where the agent chose a1, got a rare transition to S2 and no reward: then it is usually 8-10, but drops to about 4-6 when the agent had won one or two trials just before, and to 0-2 after a run of a1 wins or very early in the episode. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every D1 after a rewarded trial, after a common unrewarded trial (about 4 only if that came after a2), and after any a2 choice.
